scene.background: a row of brightly painted Mediterranean-style buildings — pastel pink, mint green, ochre, and terracotta — lines the coast, with palm trees and small umbrellas
scene.lighting: natural lighting that suggests midday, casting soft, defined shadows on the sand. The white balance is neutral to slightly warm, enhancing the golden tones of the sand and the vibrant turquoise of the sea. Color saturation is rich but natural — the sky is a brilliant azure with voluminous, puffy white cumulus clouds; the sea transitions from deep turquoise near the shore to a lighter, almost electric blue further out
scene.camera_angle: slightly elevated, wide-angle perspective — as if taken with a reflex camera in an open, natural setting
scene.style: professional photograph, not a smartphone or vintage shot — clean, high-definition, with no grain or digital noise, and rich in texture and detail from the sand grains to the fabric of the towel and the ripples in the water
scene.mood: serene, warm, and leisurely — evoking the tranquil joy of a perfect summer day at the seaside
scene.color_palette: vivid yet harmonious, dominated by blues, sandy beige, and the warm terracotta and pastel hues of the colorful coastal buildings in the background
